question: Should affected shared databases automatically canonicalize `task_runs.delivery_status = 'not-requested'` during database open, in addition to normalizing future sidecar imports?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and well-proven, but automatic mutation of persisted user state is an upgrade-boundary choice protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept automatic repair
options.body: Use the proposed idempotent one-literal transaction so already-archived upgrades recover without manual SQL or the original sidecar.

options.title: Require explicit doctor repair
options.body: Move existing-database repair behind a doctor migration, accepting that affected runtime opens remain broken until the operator runs it.

recommendation.title: Accept automatic repair
recommendation.body: Use the proposed idempotent one-literal transaction so already-archived upgrades recover without manual SQL or the original sidecar.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing evidence connects Peter to the current shared task-state migration, parser, and restoration boundary.
